## What the workshop found

- **Inspection intervals** were set in 2019 and never revised.
- **Corrosion data** sits in three systems that do not share identifiers, so engineers reconcile it by hand before every quarterly review.
- **Coating records** are kept on paper at each site.
- **Drone surveys** miss the splash zone, where most of the wall loss is found.
- **Training** for new inspectors is informal.
:::
